body: Found by the external review of PR #28's F4 cadence phase. KL_srp_top.sv:1093-1097 re-draws CAD_LA_MSRP_C only on the timer's own expiry; dec_la_msrp_w never touches cad_dl_r/need_draw_r. 802.1Q-2018 Table 10-5's LeaveAll state machine transitions rLA! -> Passive and RESTARTS the leavealltimer - the damping that stops N participants from all running LeaveAll cycles concurrently (10.7.4.3). Observed in F4: the DUT's own LeaveAll fired inside cycle 4 (~25.2 s) despite 1 Hz peer LeaveAlls; a conformant participant defers while a peer is cycling. Exposure: extra (bounded, join-paced) MRPDU traffic on busy segments - the F4 pins measured the engine staying bounded even so. Fix shape: dec_la_msrp_w also re-arms the MSRP LeaveAll cadence draw; a mutation restoring expiry-only re-draw goes red on an F4-style probe asserting no own LeaveAll inside N peer cycles.

comments.body: [A10] Consolidated: #108 (filed 2026-09-23 during the PR #107 review) tracks this same deviation with a clause-level acceptance (802.1Q-2014 Table 10-5 rLA! and 10.6, per attribute type), and PR #107's docs section 6.5 points to it. Closing this issue as a duplicate of #108; its history stays linked there.

title: A received LeaveAll does not restart the local leavealltimer (802.1Q Table 10-5 damping)
